psd_quarter_turn.expected_response: radial Hann-windowed log-PSD remains within reference range

copyist.expected_response: localized closeness to training is observed

result.effect_definition: median generated-to-train NN minus median real-to-train NN

status_semantics.CLOSER_TO_TRAINING: the regional central comparison range lies below zero; this pattern is consistent with localized training replay
status_semantics.FARTHER_FROM_TRAINING: the regional central comparison range lies above zero; this does not establish physical inadmissibility or a global manifold failure
status_semantics.CENTRAL_RANGE_OVERLAPS_ZERO: the descriptive regional comparison range overlaps zero

result.comparison_range: central 95.0% paired resampling range; conditional on the supplied training, held-out, and generated archives
result.multiplicity: none; regional summaries are descriptive and not aggregated

copy_fraction.expected_response: localized closeness strengthens as exact replay fraction increases
